name: Chimecane
description: Study a foe's armor for the narrow seams at throat and joint where a dart can bite.

name: Perceptive Reedtube
description: Hone a dart's tip on a whetstone to a fine needle point that finds plate gaps.

name: Tubeelixir
description: Seat a heavy short dart with a tight wad so the blow drives it hard.

name: Rumble Huff
description: Blow a needle dart at a visible armor gap from close range.

name: Novacane
description: Concentrate qi at the dart's point to slip it between the rings of a mail shirt.

name: Lancing Hiss
description: Blow a spiking dart at the eye slit of a helm from side on.

name: Puff Sprint
description: Circle a plated foe at the edge of its reach while hunting for a gap and never standing still.

name: Iron Exhale
description: Pour a full surge of qi into one breath so a spiked dart pierces a plate seam and sinks deep.

name: Dartneedle Onslaught
description: Fire a rapid run of darts at one spot on the armor until the plate shifts and the last dart finds flesh.

name: Intent Mouthend
description: Fold a dark cloak over the tube and arm so only the lips and the muzzle's tip show.

name: Gust Plug
description: Stand at the edge of a shadow so the face and tube melt into the dark.

name: Airbore Elixir
description: Count the lamps and their passing lights to time a shot when a street goes dim.

name: Rousing Padhead
description: Load a dart with cloth-wrapped fingers into a cloth-lined bore to kill every click.

name: Verity Dartfletch
description: Spread a faint qi sense to learn where a hidden foe stands without looking at him.

name: Rumble Needlepuff
description: Blow a qi-softened dart that makes no sound in flight and thumps into the target.

name: Intentexhale
description: Shoot darts from several hidden spots in turn so a foe cannot tell where the shooter stands.

name: Mayhem Tube
description: Scatter a handful of darts to either side and slip away so pursuers chase the wrong sounds.

name: Sustaining Tube
description: Spread each breath outward until qi rings the body and tube like a thin shell.

name: Tuberemedy
description: Feel the bore's line through the field and align it with the target without looking.

name: Daybreak Cane
description: Start the dart with a short breath and let the surrounding field carry it on.

name: Mindful Mouthpiece
description: Wash the dart point in a thin sheen of field qi before it leaves the bore.

name: Facet Puff
description: Blow one dart that travels inside the field's guidance across a wide gap.

name: Splintering Burst
description: Fire after exhaling fully and draw the push from the field instead of the lungs.

name: Exhalethrash
description: Guide a dart in flight with the field so a small curve brings it around cover.

name: Mouthend Greave
description: Thicken the field around the shooter's head and throat to turn aside a stray strike.

name: Novahiss
description: Feed one long exhale through the field to send a continuous stream of darts at a distant foe.

name: Hollowexhale
description: Gather the whole field behind a single breath so one dart drives through a guard.

name: Plugremedy
description: Read the dart's arc against the sky to judge its fall at great range.

name: Exhale Leap
description: Set a wide braced stance that lets the whole body lean into the tube.

name: Intent Reedtube
description: Choose a dart weight by the length of the shot and the strength of the day's air.

name: Unmaking Needlepuff
description: Let the breath out in a slow even trickle so the dart leaves the bore without a wobble.

name: Burstassault
description: Aim high with qi behind the blow so the dart climbs and then falls on a distant mark.

name: Chime Dartfletch
description: Fire a ranging dart and read where it falls then fire again with the corrected aim.

name: Plugelixir
description: Feel a target's warmth and breath through the field at long range when light fails.

name: Nova Burst
description: Send one qi-hardened dart across an open field in a single enormous breath.

name: Tempered Airbore
description: Lob a dart high so it falls steeply and drives into a target behind low cover.

name: Verity Dartneedle
description: Match two reeds of equal length and bore so both blow at the same strength.

name: Rousing Mouthpiece
description: Swap the mouthpiece between the lips and the free hand's reed in one smooth turn.

name: Measured Plug
description: Keep a quiet count of darts loaded in each reed to avoid a dry blow.

name: Granite Hiss
description: Stand with the feet in two even tracks so either reed can swing to the front.

name: Rumblehiss
description: Blow a first dart from the right reed while the left stays loaded and ready.

name: Airbore Torment
description: Fire both reeds one after the other so the second dart lands on the first one's heels.

name: Scorching Tube
description: Cross the two tubes and blow them together so the darts meet the target from two lines.

name: Annealed Cane
description: Hold the paired reeds in a cross to bat aside a blade and then blow from one of them.

name: Funneling Padhead
description: Alternate the two reeds in a steady beat so a fast pair of darts is always in flight.

name: Tempered Huff
description: Blow two qi-pointed darts side by side so both strike the same mailed spot.

name: Tubelinctus
description: Fix both eyes on one point of the target until the rest of the world blurs.

name: Racing Huff
description: Settle onto a still perch of knee and elbow like a hawk waiting on a branch.

name: Invigorating Mouthend
description: Load a pair of darts into two parallel channels cut along one reed.

name: Hoarfrost Dartneedle
description: Send both darts of the twin bore from one clean breath at the same mark.

name: Facettube
description: Drop the muzzle in a sudden dive and loose both darts as the target looks up.

name: Cane Linctus
description: Sweep the gaze and the field across the open sky of the shot to find the target's heading.

name: Tubetorment
description: Drive both darts of the twin bore into one tight place so they strike like two talons.

name: Rumble Mouthpiece
description: Drop from a high perch and shoot a heavy pair of darts at a ground target in one dive.

name: Mightburst
description: Find firm footing on a wet bank and settle the weight before the blow.

name: Waningcane
description: Read the run of water and reeds to learn which way the air moves over the stream.

name: Heartening Reedtube
description: Crouch in a stand of reeds with the tube pointed out between the stems.

name: Renewing Padhead
description: Glance at the water's surface to see a target behind you without turning.

name: Burstthrash
description: Blow a dart across a stream to the far bank in one smooth breath.

name: Glintplug
description: Fire through morning mist by the feel of the target's shape and sound.

name: Rumbletube
description: Aim ahead of a boat or swimmer drifting downstream so the dart meets it.

name: Unshaken Mouthend
description: Drop low behind a ripple of reeds as qi thickens round the body.

name: Intent Hiss
description: Shoot darts along the line of a river path to keep marchers off the bank.

name: Toxin Dartfletch
description: Plant a row of dart-tipped stakes at a river bend and wait with the tube to finish whoever trips them.

name: Grinding Plug
description: Sweep a long flood of darts across a broad stretch of bank in one spent breath.

name: Verityplug
description: Pause and take a line to the mark by a cliff edge or a cairn or a tree line.

name: Granite Exhale
description: Stand with the breeze at the shoulder so it neither shoves the dart nor blows the breath back.

name: Tube Tincture
description: Say the sworn count under the breath and match each blow to a beat of it.

name: Equipoise Mouthpiece
description: Rest the tube on a rolled cloak on bare ground for a steady prone line.

name: Needlepuff Maelstrom
description: Wait for a lull in the gust and then blow a dart across the plateau.

name: Gust Cane
description: Keep one fixed bearing and blow a series of darts on it while the target walks into line.

name: Might Dartneedle
description: Shift a pace with a sudden gale to keep the line on the mark while the dart is loaded.

name: Lambasting Puff
description: Let a strong crosswind bend a qi-fed dart around a rock to a target beyond it.

name: Lancing Burst
description: Blow darts along a plateau lip to keep a climbing foe from topping the edge.

name: Soaring Burst
description: Plant both feet and stand still as an oath until the breath has quieted.

name: Rousing Dartfletch
description: Crouch low along a ridge so the body breaks no skyline.

name: Waning Airbore
description: Draw a breath through the open mouth to taste the wind's direction and damp.

name: Intent Padhead
description: Load darts to a murmured count so a rhythm sets before the shot.

name: Chime Plug
description: Blow a hushed dart that flies on the wind with no sound a guard can hear.

name: Gust Exhale
description: Lock the muzzle on a bearing and fire only when the target crosses it.

name: Mightexhale
description: Cross open ground in the lulls of the wind so the gusts cover the sound of footfalls.

name: Steadfast Reedtube
description: Hold a sworn breath and let the field thicken about the body against a glancing shot.

name: Iron Hiss
description: Judge wind and range and bearing in one still breath and send a dart into a guard's weak point.

name: Rumbleburst
description: Wait for the dead hush between gusts and loose a field-driven dart across the plateau.

name: Daybreak Mouthend
description: Sling the long reed across the chest on a strap so both hands are free on the march.

name: Glancing Puff
description: Lie flat at a cliff edge with the tube's tip beyond the rim.

name: Keen Mouthpiece
description: Sight along a cairn and a distant crag to hold a straight bearing for the dart.

name: Might Padhead
description: Draw a deep hollow breath through the nose and hold it at the ribs.

name: Silt Dartneedle
description: Swing the long reed slowly in an arc across the sky to pick up a moving mark.

name: Facet Needlepuff
description: Blow a heavy dart across a gap where the wind runs hard.

name: Rupturing Cane
description: Send a qi-driven dart across a deep gorge to a target on the far lip.

name: Blaze Exhale
description: Time the blow to an updraft that lifts the dart over a ridge.

name: Might Airbore
description: Hold the breath through a hard gust and keep the tube still until it passes.

name: Renewing Plug
description: Count the gusts in a series and fire at the same point in the next.

name: Tubethrash
description: Pour qi through the full length of the reed to drive a dart through a guard at great reach.

name: Huff Assault
description: Blow a sustained hail of darts along a cliff path so no foe can walk it.
